create_mock_unit: create a MockUnit instance by calling MockUnit.new with a db, assignment, index, and pay_amount
launch_mock_task: launch a mock task by calling MockUnit.launch with a task_url to set status to LAUNCHED
expire_mock_unit: expire a MockUnit immediately by calling MockUnit.expire to set status to EXPIRED and return 0.0
check_mock_unit_expired: check if a MockUnit is expired by calling MockUnit.is_expired to query the datastore
review_mockunit_class: review the MockUnit class and its launch, expire, is_expired, and new methods for mock crowd provider usage
